svg.text: gemma4-E2B GRPO step on TPU v7x 4x4x4 (64 chips = 128 devices, TP1 x DP128) — where the time goes and where each lever bites
Clean step g4r68: rollout 31.4 s (88%) · trainer 3.8 s · weight-sync 0.45 s · rewards 0.2 s · global 35.7 s. Banked stack g4ucf: ~27 s. Numbers in red = lever and measured effect.
Pathways head (one Python process, 44 cores, serial)
1. Admit 2048 requests (256 prompts x 8), route each to a DP rank
least_loaded probes all 128 ranks per request (2048 proxy IPCs/window) → round_robin: −72 s (g4r20b→g4r56)
2. Merge / pad / ONE global decode submission per continue-decode window
window 64 → 512 : −11 s (g4r33→g4r32b); md 1024→1536 flat (orchestration off the critical path)
3. device_get → stop scan → re-pack → update 128 scheduler children
EOS-check interval 8 → 32: −4 % (g4uca); 64 is worse (g4ucb)
4. detok / logprobs / answer-extract / reward scoring (64-proc pool)
async off the critical path: rewards 12 s → 0.2 s; async reward −5.6 s (g4r35↔g4r32b)
Serial host cost per window scales with DP: 0.78 s @64 → 2.4 s @128 (xplane/Perfetto)
Devices ~2-3 % busy in the g4r19 baseline (52 ms device per 2.5 s window)
TPU mesh: 128 DP engines, one compiled continue-decode program (vLLM / tpu_inference)
Prefill (ISL ~150 tok)
~0.02 s, compute-bound
prefix caching ON = −6 s WORSE (33j)
Weight stream per decode step
9.26 GB bf16 / 7.37 TB/s = 1.3 ms (HBM roof)
int8 weights: no HBM win (bf16 resident), reward 0.568
continue-decode while_loop (fused: forward → logits → sample → KV update), 16 seqs/rank
Device op split (xplane): RPA attention over growing KV ~46 % · 262k-vocab logits+sampling ~40 % · GEMM ~2 %
approx_max_k replaces exact top-k over 262144: 0.709 → 0.263 ms, −3 % step, reward-exact (g4ubz)
RPA tiling: default tiles already fastest (80.6 µs/call); forced 1,8192 = 29 s vs 27 s (g4uci)
Measured per-step wall ~5.4 ms (CDTIMING) ≈ device floor incl. attention + vocab path; pure-decode ~2.4 ms/token
STRAGGLER: makespan = longest completion x per-step time. ~8 chips grind the tail while ~24 idle in collective-permute-done
Reward scoring (host pool, 64 procs)
math_verify + check_numbers per completion
parallel pool 30 s → 8-10 s; per-item sympy timeout
kills 156 s spikes → 0.26 s (g4r32c)
async during rollout: 0.2 s/step (g4r55)
length reward-shaping / adv-bias: INERT under GRPO
Actor update (same 128 devices, FSDP)
GRPO loss over packed 8192-token rows
flash/splash trainer attn + jit_unroll: 15 → ~4 s
TMBS 8 / HBM 0.3: null at win64 (g4r40)
now 3.7 s (g4r68); roofline ~0.8 s
Weight sync → engines: 0.45 s
keep-KV + jit-unroll: 1.0 → 0.45 s (at floor)
weight sync (fsdp → DP replicas)
One clean step, to scale (g4r68 best config, 35.7 s)
rollout = engine_generate 31.4 s (88 %) : ~8 windows x 512 tokens; device 5.2 s + serial host ~26 s in the g4r68 analysis
train 3.8
sync+rw
Same step after the straggler campaign (g4ucf banked, ~27 s)
rollout ~25 s : longest completion capped at 2560 tok x ~5.4 ms/step (device-bound floor incl. attention + 262k vocab)
train
← 7.5 s removed (−22 %); 2048 cap removes ~3 s more at the reward floor
Roofline ladder (per device, TP1 replica, batch 16 seqs/rank, OSL ~1420-2560)
v1 (weights only): 9.26 GB / 7.37 TB/s = 1.3 ms/step → 1.8-3.3 s rollout floor → "7x gap" → drove the host-work hunt (rr routing, windows, async host work): 175.6 → 34.5 s.
v2 (healthy model, 2026-09-04): decode 4.4 + trainer 0.8 + prefill 0.02 + sync 0.5 = 5.7 s/step → "6.3x gap, all rollout host overhead" at 35.7 s.
v3 (CDTIMING, 2026-10-24): measured 4.8-5.9 ms per decode step, constant vs active seqs → device-bound; attention over KV + 262k-vocab path are ~4 ms the weight-only floor ignored.
Consequence: the reclaimable gap is the straggler LENGTH, not kernels. Rollout = longest-of-2048 completion x 5.4 ms. OSL cap is the lever that moved it; reweighting cannot (max-of-N argument).
